event.name: Shark Tank App-Build Challenge
event.location: Howard University, Washington D.C. & Amazon HQ2

format.presentation: 2-minute overview per team (team name + what the app does; no live demo required)
format.voting: Peer voting within breakout room (1 vote per team, cannot vote for own team). Top team becomes room champion.
format.finals: Room champions present to head judges on the main stage for overall win.

tools.primary: Amazon Quick (Recommended path: Apps — describe app in plain English to build working web app. Alternative: Chat)

scenarios.title: Fuel Up: Healthy Eating Coach
scenarios.mission: First-year students are living on ramen and vending-machine snacks. Build an app that helps a student eat better on a tight budget and busy schedule.
requirements: Enter fridge/dining-hall options and get quick, healthy meal ideas
Get a grocery list that fits a weekly budget they set
Ask nutrition questions and get friendly, non-judgy answers
stretch_goals: Generate a motivational 'meal of the day' image
Suggest swaps based on a goal
Adjust for allergies or vegetarian/halal preferences

scenarios.title: Study Buddy: The AI Learning Sidekick
scenarios.mission: Studying alone is hard and boring. Build a study companion that helps a student understand tough material and stay on track for exams.
requirements: Paste in notes or a topic and get a plain-English explanation
Get a study plan for the days before an exam
stretch_goals: Adopt a 'tutor personality' the student can choose
Explain a concept at 3 difficulty levels

scenarios.title: Money Moves: Student Budget Planner
scenarios.mission: Managing money in college is stressful and rarely taught. Build an app that helps a student understand their spending and plan ahead.
requirements: Enter income and expenses to see where money goes
Get a simple monthly budget they can adjust
Ask money questions and get clear guidance
stretch_goals: Set a savings goal and show how long it'll take

scenarios.title: Campus Compass: Navigate College Life
scenarios.mission: New students don't know where to go, what's happening, or who to ask. Build a friendly guide that helps them find their footing on campus.
requirements: Ask questions about campus life and get welcoming answers
Get club/event suggestions based on interests
Find the right office or resource for a problem
stretch_goals: Create a hype image for a club or event

scenarios.title: Balance: Wellness & Stress Companion
scenarios.mission: Navigating academic rigor, social shifts, and college pressure leads to burnout and stress. Build an empathetic companion to help students decompress, manage stress, and access campus mental health resources.
requirements: Check in on daily mood/stress level and receive calming, constructive exercises or check-ins
Guided breathing, micro-meditation, or quick reset routines between classes
Direct routing and guidance to campus counseling, wellness centers, and crisis resources
stretch_goals: Generate personalized self-care challenges or calming visualizations
Mood tracking insights showing weekly stress triggers and trends
Positive affirmation generator tailored to exam or presentation anxiety
scenarios.note: Extrapolated from handout scenario header and student wellness domain context.
